name: skye-advanced-pattern-pack
purpose: Production-minded implementation patterns that actually use Motion, GSAP, Lenis, Three.js, React Three Fiber, Drei, and postprocessing.
rule: Agents must pull open-source recipes first, then one of these implementation patterns before building a premium public surface. Do not merely describe motion or 3D; use a pattern, wire real imports into source, and pass design_stack_audit.
auditRule: Package installs, prose, static canvas substitutes, and repeated dark card templates fail. Required open-source stack must be imported and visibly used in runtime source.

patterns.title: Cinematic Command Hero
patterns.quality: Full-width editorial headline, living WebGL command object, proof strip, CTA, reduced-motion-safe composition.

patterns.title: Scroll Proof Funnel
patterns.quality: Pinned/scrubbed funnel for process storytelling without turning the page into cards and paragraphs.

patterns.title: Neon Motion Chrome
patterns.quality: Legal Skyes-style neon scrollbar plus scroll progress, scanline atmosphere, pointer-reactive cursor glow, shimmer text utilities, magnetic hover utilities, mobile and reduced-motion fallbacks.

patterns.title: App-First Command Center
patterns.quality: The first viewport is the tool surface itself: tabs, status, controls, proof, and action density.
